# GrowthBook & Coverflex Demo
Date: 2026-08-19 | Duration: 61.310001373291016m

## Summary
The meeting outlined key points regarding GrowthBook's capabilities in supporting EU data residency and compliance with privacy regulations, as emphasized by James Shannon. The team highlighted the integration strategy with BigQuery for efficient event processing and the necessity for sticky bucketing as a requirement not met by the open-source version. Key experimentation goals were identified, targeting small businesses to enhance conversion rates from free to paid plans, with roles specified for engineers and PMs. A timeline for decision-making was set for mid-September. Technical architecture was described, showcasing the use of GrowthBook's SDKs across various platforms and efficient attribute management for targeting. The discussion included metrics analysis and the advantages of a seat-based pricing model.

## Keywords
Experimentation, BigQuery, Data Residency, Feature Flagging, Conversion Metrics, SDK Integration
